column1: This audit used live HTTP crawls of the public website, sitemaps, robots.txt, HTML parsing, and product/collection JSON endpoints. PageSpeed Insights API quota was exceeded in this environment, so lab CWV scores were not pulled live — HTML weight and TTFB were measured directly instead. Google ranking positions, Search Console data, and paid app configurations inside Shopify admin were not accessible. Re-run PSI and GSC after implementing Phase 1–2 fixes.
